name: search_images
description: Search for licensed images from Wikimedia Commons or TheSportsDB

output.description: JSON object with {results: [{title, url, width, height, mime, license, artist, source}]}

params.name: provider
params.description: Image provider: 'commons' (Wikimedia Commons) or 'sportsdb' (TheSportsDB team badges)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return
